poem: 雲開見月正分明，枯木逢春再發榮。舊事消散新事順，貴人扶助自然成。
poemEn: Clouds part to reveal a clear moon; dead trees bloom in spring again. Past troubles scatter, future endeavors flow smoothly with noble guidance.
notes: 近期壓抑許久的事會逐漸明朗，過去卡住的計畫適合重新啟動；貴人多在身邊熟識的人之中。
notesEn: Past obstacles will clarify; ideal time to restart paused projects with support from friends.

poem: 船到江心風浪靜，前途坦蕩少憂驚。凡事只要心誠正，自有神明暗中行。
poemEn: When the boat reaches mid-river the waves calm; a smooth path lies ahead with few worries. Walk with an honest heart and divine help will follow silently.
notes: 過程雖有波折，但只要按部就班、不投機取巧，結果會比預期平穩。
notesEn: Though there may be ripples, staying grounded and honest brings better results than expected.

poem: 半山半水未為奇，且向前村問路歧。莫道此行無伴侶，同心自有好相知。
poemEn: Halfway up the mountain between water and mist, ask for directions at the next village. Do not feel lonely on this journey; kindred spirits await.
theme: 尚在摸索，需要請教他人
notes: 現在的方向還不算明確，適合多方打聽、找有經驗的人商量，不要獨自悶頭做決定。
notesEn: Your direction is still forming; consult experienced friends rather than deciding in isolation.

poem: 花開花謝有定時，人生際遇不強求。耐心等待春風至，自然結果滿枝頭。
poemEn: Flowers bloom and wither in their own time; do not force life's opportunities. Wait patiently for the spring breeze and fruits will fill the branches.
notes: 不是不會成，是時候未到；急於求成反而容易亂了步調，先把手邊能做的做好。
notesEn: Success takes time; focus on doing current work well without rushing.

poem: 路遠馬疲人未歇，前村燈火尚微茫。莫嫌此去多辛苦，行到山窮水又長。
poemEn: The road is long, the horse weary, yet the traveler presses on toward faint lights in the distance. Do not complain of hard effort; perseverance leads through deep waters.
notes: 目前處於付出多、回報還不明顯的階段；提醒自己這是過程，不是結果。
notesEn: Current effort yields delayed results; remember this is a journey toward growth.

poem: 風急雨驟莫遠行，且待雲收月自明。此時強求多阻滯，退一步時海闊天。
poemEn: Do not travel far during sudden rainstorms; wait until clouds part for the moon to shine. Forcing progress now brings obstacles; taking a step back opens broad skies.
notes: 不建議在這個時間點做重大決定或遠行、投入大筆資源；先觀望、把風險降低。
notesEn: Avoid major financial decisions or long trips for now; reduce risks and observe.

poem: 枯樹逢春花又開，故人相見笑顏來。多年心事今朝了，喜氣重重報吉祥。
poemEn: Withered trees bloom again as spring returns; old friends meet with joyful smiles. Longstanding worries resolve today, bringing abundance of good tidings.
notes: 適合修復關係、重新聯繫許久未見的人；懸而未決的舊事會有一個了結。
notesEn: Great time to mend relationships and reconnect with old acquaintances; pending matters resolve.

poem: 鏡中花影未為真，虛實之間費思尋。莫將傳言當定論，親自查看更分明。
poemEn: Flowers reflected in a mirror are not real; distinguishing truth from shadow takes contemplation. Do not take rumors as fact; verify with your own eyes.
notes: 現在聽到的消息或別人的評價未必準確，重要的事情自己確認過比較放心。
notesEn: Current news may be unverified; inspect details personally before committing.

poem: 舟行江上遇逆風，暫且收帆莫強攻。守成待變非退卻，蓄力方能濟長江。
poemEn: Sailing against strong head-winds, temporarily lower the sail rather than forcing forward. Holding ground is not retreat; conserving strength prepares for crossing the river.
notes: 現階段不是擴張、冒進的好時機；把力氣留著，等狀況緩和再出手。
notesEn: Hold steady instead of aggressive expansion; save energy for the right moment.

poem: 一輪明月照江心，萬里無雲天地清。此去前程多順遂，功名自有水到成。
poemEn: A bright moon illuminates the river; skies are clear for ten thousand miles. Your path ahead is peaceful and prosperous; achievement comes naturally.
notes: 整體運勢在上升期，適合主動出擊、提出計畫或表達心意；拖延反而可惜。
notesEn: Your momentum is rising; take proactive initiative and express your goals.

poem: 十字路口費躊躇，東西南北路皆殊。靜心細想根本事，自有一路是歸途。
poemEn: Hesitating at a crossroads where four paths diverge; quiet your heart and recall your original goal, for one path will lead you home.
notes: 面臨多個選項難以取捨時，建議先問自己最初的目的是什麼，答案往往就在裡面。
notesEn: When facing tough choices, ask yourself your original intention for clear direction.

poem: 春雨如膏潤物新，田園漸綠見精神。辛勤耕耘終有獲，莫嫌此刻未成林。
poemEn: Spring rain moistens the earth anew; fields turn green with fresh vitality. Diligent cultivation will yield harvest; do not mind that the forest is not yet tall.
notes: 目前的努力並沒有白費，只是成果還在累積階段，繼續照原本的節奏走。
notesEn: Your persistent hard work is building momentum; keep moving steadily.

poem: 金榜題名光耀門，平生志向今日申。喜逢盛世人才聚，富貴雙全享太平。
poemEn: Golden names listed high bring honor; lifelong aspirations bloom today. Gathering talent in prosperous times brings joy and lasting peace.
notes: 此籤代表學業、考試、轉職或升遷有極大助益，只要平時有所準備，定能脫穎而出。
notesEn: Highly favorable for exams, career moves, or promotions; preparation leads to standout success.

poem: 良緣天定結同心，月下老人暗相引。兩情相悅無猜疑，百年好合共長春。
poemEn: Destined affinity joined under the moon; guided secretly by the Old Man of the Moon. Shared affection without doubt brings a century of harmonious love.
notes: 問感情者此籤大吉，單身者有機會結識良緣，有對象者感情加溫，適合論及婚嫁。
notesEn: A joyful fortune for romance; singles find good connections, couples deepen harmony.

poem: 財如源泉滾滾來，商業興隆大發財。積善之家必有慶，正財偏財兩相宜。
poemEn: Wealth flows like a rolling spring; business flourishes with prosperity. A righteous household earns blessings; both steady and windfall income prosper.
notes: 求財大吉，適合穩健投資或開啟新業務，同時提醒多做善事、保持誠信經營。
notesEn: Favorable for wealth and business expansion; maintain integrity and share goodwill.

poem: 疾病纏身莫憂心，調理身心養精神。遵醫處方安心服，自然安康體回春。
poemEn: Do not worry over temporary illness; nurture your mind and spirit with rest. Follow medical wisdom with peace of mind and full health will return.
notes: 問健康者提醒多注意生活作息與飲食，若有不適應及早檢查，遵從醫囑即能康復。
notesEn: Focus on rest, balanced diet, and timely medical advice for swift recovery.

poem: 訟事紛爭宜解和，各退一步自然妥。得理饒人邊界寬，莫隨口舌引風波。
poemEn: Disputes are best resolved through harmony; taking a step back settles matters. Generosity creates wider boundaries; avoid sharp words that cause storms.
notes: 遇到紛爭爭執時，以和為貴是上策。退一步海闊天空，切忌口舌逞快而擴大矛盾。
notesEn: Seek peace over conflict; stepping back avoids unnecessary arguments.

poem: 出門遠行見祥雲，吉星高照保安寧。東西南北皆順遂，滿載而歸喜氣盈。
poemEn: Auspicious clouds guide your travel; lucky stars shine to preserve peace. All directions bring smooth paths; return home fulfilled with joy.
notes: 問旅遊、出差、留學或移居者大吉，出途平安且能獲取預期的收穫。
notesEn: Excellent for travel, business trips, or study abroad; safe and rewarding.

poem: 防人防己防小人，虛情假意陷迷津。切莫輕信甜言語，慎選朋友保清真。
poemEn: Beware of insincerity and petty traps; do not easily trust sweet words. Choose companions wisely to keep your path clear and true.
notes: 近期需提防小人讒言或金錢陷阱，未經核實的投資或合作切勿冒然投入。
notesEn: Guard against financial traps or unverified claims; double-check all agreements.

poem: 神仙保佑萬事通，福祿壽喜齊降臨。家庭和睦人人樂，事業長青歲歲隆。
poemEn: Deities protect and grant smooth fortune; health, longevity, and joy descend together. Family harmony brings happiness to all, and career thrives year after year.
notes: 極佳之吉籤！代表天時地利人和兼備，全家平安、事業順利、身心皆得康泰。
notesEn: A top-grade blessing; family harmony, health, and career are fully protected.
